configurePresets.name: conf-light_ui-host-debug
configurePresets.description: The host build, and the configuration that registers this group's tests (light_canvas's suite, and whatever the other modules grow). Plain host rather than pico_hostmode: nothing in the group needs the Pico SDK's host build.

configurePresets.description: The po13 demo rig -- a Pico 2 in an SWD dock wearing the Pico-OLED-1.3 expansion board. Split by chip into its own tree, the same arrangement crossfire and screen-test use.

configurePresets.name: conf-light_ui-waveshare-touch169-debug
configurePresets.description: The touch demo on the Waveshare RP2350-Touch-LCD-1.69. The boot command and the CDC connect-wait knob moved here from screen-test along with the demo that consumes them.
